cohort: 8,693,616 individuals in 5 states (California, Michigan, Missouri, Pennsylvania, and South Carolina) delivering a fetal death or live birth between 2008 and 2020
finding: Sickle cell disease was found to be an important contributor to racial disparities in SMM and was associated with an elevated risk of SMM among Black individuals.
mod_finding: Black individuals with sickle cell disease had a higher rate of cesarean delivery compared to Black individuals without sickle cell disease.
